name: dhis2-chap
description: Internal Claude Code plugins for the DHIS2 CHAP modeling platform.

plugins.name: hello-world
plugins.description: Example plugin — a starting template with one slash command and one skill.

plugins.name: improve-chap-model
plugins.description: Iteratively improve an existing CHAP model: evaluate with the chap CLI, tune code/config, and track every experiment with git for reproducibility.

plugins.name: discourse
plugins.description: Set up and use the Discourse MCP server against the DHIS2 Community of Practice (community.dhis2.org): search and read topics, draft release announcements and replies in the Chap category.

plugins.name: convert-to-chapkit
plugins.description: Convert an existing CHAP model repo (MLproject plus train/predict scripts, Python or R) into a chapkit 2.x ML service, gated on numeric parity with the pre-conversion predictions.

plugins.name: jira-audit
plugins.description: Audit CLIM Jira against the chap repos: wrong statuses, outdated descriptions, duplicates, missing components, epics missing from the roadmap page or unlinked from ROADMAP ideas, ideas without an epic. Shareable report with tiered proposed changes; applies what you approve. Run /jira-audit.

plugins.name: product-landscape-diagram
plugins.description: Workshop facilitator: interviews a group about the products and tools from getting data into DHIS2 to enabling decisions, and draws a live, zoomable diagram of how they relate. Run /product-landscape-diagram.

plugins.name: write-issue
plugins.description: Write or revise Jira epics and issues from discussion, not guesses. Asks before drafting, uses a fixed epic format, asks who to show the work to, and links new epics from the team roadmap. Also writes Chap and Open Geo Service ideas in the DHIS2 Roadmap (ROADMAP) project, and handles action points in the Climate team task tracking (CTI) project: adding them, capturing them from pasted or linked meeting notes, listing and closing them.

plugins.name: docs-review
plugins.description: Review documentation across the modeling platform and climate team repos for holes: docs vs code, overlap between sources, reader journeys, structure and links. Shareable report. Run /docs-review.

plugins.name: sprint-review
plugins.description: Produce the end-of-sprint review reports for the CLIM team, one for Chap and one for GeoService — what got done and how it serves the 6-month objectives, unplanned work, unfinished and languishing items, demo candidates, and improvement suggestions. Run Friday end of day for the Monday meeting. Requires the Atlassian MCP connector.

plugins.name: sprint-plan
plugins.description: Draft the start-of-sprint email to the head of the project: a very brief, plain-language summary of the CLIM team's sprint (Chap epics and GeoService user stories), grouped by 6-month objective. Run after sprint planning. Requires the Atlassian MCP connector.
